annotations.title: Write and save a list with Justy

description: Justy writes a list from one sentence (for example "shopping for Friday dinner for 8") and saves it to the user's Just List account. Shopping lists come sorted by aisle. Returns the saved list's id and link. Counts toward the account's daily Justy lists; when those are used up it says so, and create_list still works.

lang.description: he or en when the sentence alone is ambiguous

sentence.description: The user's request in one sentence, in their own words and language

name: write_list_with_justy

aisle.description: Aisle token (produce, dairy, …) for shopping lists; null otherwise

title: Write and save a list with Justy
